name: 闪婚甜妻竟能续命
overview: After her fate is stolen, mysticism-savvy Xu Jinhuan is cursed with a shortened life and enters a contract marriage with terminally ill tycoon heir Fu Jinxiu to survive. Bound by a strange life-extension system, they battle family conspiracies and a ticking clock, only to discover that love may be their only way out.
